decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using elves like Llanowar Elves and Priest of Titania, along with Gaea's Cradle. This allows for explosive plays such as casting Hunting Pack for a large number of tokens. Additionally, the deck aims to utilize creatures with abilities like Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger to generate value and protect key pieces like Survival of the Fittest. The deck also includes a few powerful finishers like Deranged Hermit and Kamahl, Fist of Krosa to close out games quickly.

The main focus of the deck is to quickly assemble and protect the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought with Stifle, allowing for a powerful win condition. The deck utilizes a variety of counterspells and card draw to maintain control over the game while searching for key pieces. Powder Keg is included as additional removal, while Vision Charm and Flash of Insight provide additional flexibility and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own combo for a quick victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using Elf creatures and Gaea's Cradle to cast powerful threats such as Verdant Force and Deranged Hermit. The deck also utilizes cards like Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger to generate additional mana and value from its creatures. Survival of the Fittest and Natural Order provide additional utility in finding key creatures like Anger or Kamahl, Fist of Krosa to push through damage and overwhelm opponents. Overall, the deck aims to swarm the board with aggressive Elves and overwhelm the opponent before they can set up their own game plan.

This deck focuses on using various removal spells and disruption tactics to control the game while also applying pressure with Zombie Infestation and Nether Spirit. It aims to continuously disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Duress, Cabal Therapy, and Contamination while also drawing cards and gaining advantage with Skeletal Scrying. The deck utilizes land destruction with Wasteland and Rishadan Port along with creature destruction to keep the opponent on the back foot, ultimately grinding out a victory through attrition.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy and controlling the game through various spells and abilities. It includes cards that can destroy opponent's artifacts and enchantments, removal spells to get rid of threats, card draw with Sylvan Library to maintain resources, discard spells like Duress to disrupt the opponent's hand, and a win condition with The Rack to deal damage. It also includes creatures like Rotting Giant for some board presence. The deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through attrition.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with low-cost, aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key concept is to put pressure on the opponent early in the game while also maintaining control of the board through removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate. The deck aims to maintain a steady stream of threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Wasteland and Naturalize. The inclusion of cards like Grim Lavamancer and Sulfuric Vortex provide additional reach and inevitability in the late game.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using cards like Mox Diamond and Weathered Wayfarer to cast powerful threats like Terravore and Nimble Mongoose. By utilizing Armageddon and Wasteland, the deck disrupts the opponent's mana base while protecting its own with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate. The strategy aims to apply early pressure and control the game by destroying lands and maintaining board presence through efficient creature spells. The key idea is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive threats and disrupt their game plan through land destruction.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells and removal spells while drawing cards to maintain card advantage. The deck also aims to set up a solid board presence with creatures like Exalted Angel, Psychatog, and Meddling Mage. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Cataclysm and Weathered Wayfarer helps to control the board state and manipulate the game to the player's advantage. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana for powerful plays.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive goblin creatures, using cards like Goblin Lackey to cheat them into play early, while also providing support and utility with cards like Gempalm Incinerator and Siege-Gang Commander. The deck aims to maintain control of the board with removal spells like Hearth Charm and Naturalize, while also disrupting the opponent's resources with cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy by providing both red and green mana sources.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by using counterspells and removal spells to keep the opponent at bay. It also focuses on locking down the board with cards like Standstill and Humility, while generating advantage with Fact or Fiction. The deck utilizes lands like Dust Bowl and Mishra's Factory to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while also having win conditions like Decree of Justice and Faerie Conclave to close out the game. Overall, the strategy is to control the game until you can secure a win.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively attack the opponent using low-cost, efficient creatures in the form of Phyrexian Negator, Dauthi Slayer, and Skittering Skirge. The deck also includes disruption elements such as Duress, Cabal Therapy, and Diabolic Edict to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Dark Ritual provides additional mana acceleration to help cast the threats early on. The inclusion of cards like Sarcomancy and Grave Servitude ensures a steady stream of creatures to maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize or mount a defense.

The main focus of this Mono Blue Control deck is to maintain control of the game through counter spells and removal while accruing card advantage through draw spells like Accumulated Knowledge and Impulse. The deck also utilizes utility lands like Dust Bowl and Quicksand to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Parallax Tide provides additional control by temporarily removing threats from the game, while Powder Keg and Force Spike help to maintain board presence. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent while grinding them down with efficient control spells.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's strategy through counterspells and removal spells while utilizing the Oath of Druids enchantment to cheat powerful creatures into play. The main win condition is to ramp into Oath of Druids and put a large creature like Phantom Nishoba or Triskelion into play quickly. The deck also includes card draw and selection to ensure consistency in finding key combo pieces. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and overwhelm them with big threats once Oath of Druids is active.

The main focus of this RG Aggro deck is to aggressively play creatures and spells to put pressure on the opponent. Utilizing efficient and low-cost creatures like Grim Lavamancer, Jackal Pup, and Mogg Fanatic, along with powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. Quirion Dryad grows stronger with each spell cast, while Call of the Herd provides additional creature presence. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Naturalize and Wasteland to handle opposing threats. Overall, this deck aims to win through early aggression and efficient card usage.

This deck focuses on playing low-cost, aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The key strategy is to efficiently deal damage early on and then finish the game with powerful burn spells like Fireblast and Lightning Bolt. The inclusion of cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Price of Progress also punishes opponents for playing nonbasic lands, further enhancing the deck's ability to quickly close out games. The deck aims to be fast and relentless in its pressure, aiming to overwhelm opponents before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck relies on using
creatures with powerful abilities to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. This is achieved through a combination of graveyard recursion, hand disruption, and creature combos. The main goal is to manipulate the game state in order to outvalue the opponent and win through attrition. The deck focuses on efficient creatures and spells that can provide card advantage and disruption, allowing the pilot to outlast their opponent and establish a dominant position on the battlefield.
